description: Stop an agent below you: one of your children by its name, or a deeper agent by its path. Its running turn ends at once, and so does the turn of every agent below it; they stay idle with their context, and a message wakes them again. Each agent stopped below it tells its own parent. Set end to true once you no longer need it: it and every agent below it are retired, take no more messages, stop counting toward the limit on live agents and have their background processes stopped. Don't stop a child to wait for it, and don't end one whose report you still need.

end.description: true also retires it and every agent below it for good. false when left out.

name.description: A child's name, or the path of an agent further below you.

name: stop_agent
